        • NGO Management and CSR (Only for MSW Students) (Course Summary) 1303-
          1304:

          The Diploma in NGO Management and Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR) is a two-semester academic program designed to build foundational and advanced competencies in the non-profit and CSR sectors. Each semester includes five courses—four theory papers and one field-based project work, allowing students to blend classroom learning with real-world application.

          1305:

          The diploma spans a total of 980 hours (490 hours per semester), which includes structured classroom sessions, fieldwork, and dedicated library hours for independent study and research.

          1306-

          The program covers key areas such as NGO governance, financial and legal compliance, project design and evaluation, stakeholder engagement, and CSR strategy under Indian regulatory frameworks. Emphasis is placed on developing leadership and management skills essential for navigating today’s social development landscape.

          1307-

          Students gain practical exposure through field projects, enabling them to work closely with NGOs or CSR wings of corporates. This hands-on experience fosters critical thinking, problem-solving, and a commitment to ethical and sustainable development.

          1308:

          Ideal for students, aspiring social entrepreneurs, and professionals in the development sector, this diploma prepares graduates to effectively lead and innovate in the realms of civil society and corporate social responsibility.

    This comprehensive course provides a deep dive into both the theoretical and practical aspects of adventure sports, spanning multiple disciplines and skills. It is designed to ignite the spirit of adventure while preparing students for diverse opportunities in the field.
    Course Structure:
    The course consists of six well-structured modules, each focusing on a specific domain within adventure sports:
    Unlock Your Adventure Spirit
    A 5-day Adventure Camp at the National Adventure Institute, Pachmarhi, will offer hands-on experience in real-world outdoor settings. This exclusive camp is specially curated for students enrolled in the Certificate Course.
    Module I: Introduction to Adventure Sports
    - Definition and classification of adventure sports
    - Historical development
    - Role of weather conditions and terrain types
    Module II: Water and Aero Sports
    - Canoeing, kayaking, white-water rafting, scuba diving

    - Overview of essential equipment, clothing, and popular locations in India
    Module III: Mountaineering
    - Trekking, rock climbing, and ice climbing
    - Basic outdoor survival skills including knot tying, abseiling, and bushcraft
    Module IV: Training Institutes and Career Opportunities
    - Governing bodies, national federations, and certification authorities

    - Exploration of recreational, professional, and competitive aspects
    Module VI: Psychological Aspects and Safety Measures
    - Psychological preparedness and managing fear
    - Risk assessment, event planning, and safety protocols
Course Fees - 5000/-
1.  Advertising & Media Management (Course Summary)
    This course, with a duration of 60 hours, comprises 6 modules and is designed to provide a detailed understanding of the subject. The course includes both theoretical and practical components, ensuring a balanced learning experience. Additionally, there will be a 20-hour internship opportunity at relevant industry sites or organizations to provide practical insights and real-world exposure. This internship component is detailed under Module 6 in the syllabus. The course will be taught by a mix of internal and external faculty, depending on the expertise required for each module.
    Upon successful completion, students will receive certification from BSSS. A mandatory attendance of 75% is required to qualify for certification. The internal assessment, totaling 40 marks, will be based on presentations, assignments, projects, case studies, and internship report preparation, while the external assessment will be out of 60 marks. Students will be awarded grades based on the total marks obtained from both internal and external evaluations.
    Expected Course Outcomes:
    - Opportunities in advertising and specialist agencies, including creative and client servicing roles.
    - Development of skills in media planning, direct marketing, and digital marketing.
    - A comprehensive understanding of the field.
2.  Android Application Development (for BCA & B.Com Computer students) (Course Summary)
    This course, with a duration of 60 hours, comprises 5 modules designed to provide a comprehensive introduction to Android development. It begins with foundational Java programming concepts such as variables, operators, object-oriented programming (OOP), and database queries, before transitioning to Android-specific topics.
    The course covers the history of Android, its architecture, and the setup of the development environment, including Android Studio and AVD (Android Virtual Device) configuration. The structure includes both theoretical and practical components to ensure a balanced approach to learning. Additionally, there will be exposure visits to relevant industries to offer practical insights and real-world learning experiences. A 20-hour internship will be provided in the industry.
    The course will be taught by a mix of internal and external faculty, depending on the expertise required for each module. Upon successful completion, students will receive certification from BSSS. A mandatory attendance of 75% is required to qualify for certification.
    The internal assessment, totaling 40 marks, will be based on assignments and projects, while the external assessment will be out of 60 marks. Students will be awarded grades based on the total marks obtained from both internal and external evaluations.
    Expected Course Outcomes:
    - Build and deploy their own Android applications.
    - Understand the operation and lifecycle of an application, including configuration files, intents, and activities.
    - Understand UI concepts including components, layouts, event handling, and screen orientation.
    - Develop working knowledge of custom UI elements and their positioning.
    - Understand the concept of SQL with Android.
    These outcomes ensure that students are well-equipped with the knowledge and skills required in the field.
3.  Banking (Course Summary)
    The banking course, with a duration of 60 hours, consists of 5 modules designed to offer a comprehensive understanding of the subject matter.     The Certificate Course in Emotional Intelligence offers an in-depth understanding of emotional intelligence (EI) and its importance in enhancing personal growth, interpersonal relationships, and professional effectiveness. Learners are introduced to the five core dimensions of the Trait EI model—self-awareness, managing emotions, motivation, empathy, and social skills—along with their real-world applications. Topics include emotional self-perception, assertiveness, empathy, decision-making, stress tolerance, flexibility, and overall well-being.

Learners gain practical skills in verbal and non-verbal communication, impulse control, and team integration. 644-
645:The Bhopal School of Social Sciences was founded in the year 1972-at the initiative of Most Rev Dr Eugene D' Souza, the then Archbishop of Bhopal, in response to the need of the time for a broad-based, job-oriented curriculum with an initial focus on social service and entrepreneurship. The institution is supported and managed by the Archdiocese of Bhopal through the BSSS Society chaired by the Archbishop of Bhopal.
646-
647-Since its inception, the College has adopted an integrated and comprehensive approach to learning in order to achieve academic excellence. This vision has been the cornerstone of our growth in the last 52 years as we gradually adopted new programs, initiated innovative learner strategies, and took bold steps to go beyond the prescribed curriculum with a view to transform knowledge into affirmative action.
648-
649:Initially known for its Social Sciences and Management courses, the College grew and diversified with the introduction of courses in Commerce, Physical Education and Science. Recently, the college introduced NEP 2020 in line with the Higher Education, Government of Madhya Pradesh and commenced Four Year Degree Programme with Honours in all streams and Honours with Research in selected streams. The College also runs two international MBAs through collaboration with Assumption University, Bangkok. The college also has tie-up with IMA, US.
650-
651-With the objective of widening the educational experience of our students as well as to encourage inter-disciplinary learning, the College offers 46 certificate courses, 6 diploma courses, and 2 additional courses.
652-
653:The strength of our ideology was put to a litmus test, first in 2006, and subsequently in 2012 and 2017 by NAAC. On all the three occasions, our claim to excellence was validated through an 'A' Grade certificate. In our fourth NAAC Accreditation cycle in 2023, the college scored 3.26 CGPA with an A+ Grade which is valid till 2028. The College was granted an Autonomous Status in May 2013 with the extension of autonomy in 2019 for another term of five years. In 2024, the Autonomy was further extended for a period of ten years.
654-
655:Our endeavours have always been encouraged and guided by our Chairman, Most Rev. Dr. A. A. S. Durairaj, the Archbishop of Bhopal Diocese. Spearheaded by his vision of global education, peaceful resolution of conflict, social equality and high standards of personal conduct, The college hopes to scale new heights in the world of academia and create a conducive environment for intellectual, social, moral and spiritual growth of the world we live in.

CAMBRIDGE ENGLISH UPSKILLS

 

Upskill from Cambridge is the latest state-of-the-art technology-based language assessment to be delivered on mobile phones, offered by the producers of IELTS. The test is a completely mobile, remotely proctored English exam delivered on Android phones driven using artificial intelligence. Upskill tests all four skills: Reading and Listening, Speaking, and Writing.   

Being completely mobile, the test offers an extremely convenient way for candidates to take an assessment anywhere anytime, and get instant results through an official report from an internationally recognized examination board.  This will indicate the candidate’s overall score and your score for each skill using the CEFR level scale. The international standard for describing language ability is the Common European Framework of             Reference for Languages (CEFR). It describes language ability on a six-point scale, from A1 for beginners, up to C2 for those who have mastered a language, and has a set of CAN-DO statements. The Upskill report will tell the candidate and the organization what each score means in terms of English language ability. 

The whole test is delivered in a chunked format – this means that once started the test can be taken in small 15-20 min portions over a 5-day period, whenever the candidate has time, and is remotely proctored for authentication. 

Course Hours - 60hrs.

The Bachelor of Commerce (B.Com) programme is offered under the framework of the National Education Policy (NEP) 2020, designed as a Four-Year Undergraduate Programme (FYUGP) with multiple entry and exit options (Certificate after 1 year, Diploma after 2 years, Degree after 3 years, and Honours/Research Degree after 4 years). The programme follows a flexible, multidisciplinary and skill-oriented curriculum integrated with the Academic Bank of Credits (ABC) system.

At the undergraduate level, the college strictly follows Ordinance 14(1) and Ordinance 14(A) issued by the Department of Higher Education, Government of Madhya Pradesh, for the implementation and regulation of NEP-based programmes.

The programme is structured to meet the growing need for analytical, quantitative and research-oriented approaches to problem-solving in the rapidly evolving corporate and economic environment. It integrates foundational commerce education with applied learning, digital competencies, entrepreneurship and value-based education.

Streams Offered

The college offers B.Com under various streams including:

- Tax Procedure and Practice
- Applied Economics
- Computer Applications
- Foreign Trade Practices and Sales Management
- Principles, Practices and Management of Insurance
- Advertising and Sales Practices & Sales Management
- Tours and Travels Management

Specializations Offered

In addition, the programme offers specializations in emerging and industry-relevant domains such as:

- Business Analytics
- Innovation and Entrepreneurship
- Logistics and Supply Chain Management

Programme Objectives

The primary objective of the programme is to equip students with comprehensive knowledge, critical thinking abilities, practical skills and ethical values required to understand and analyze the complexities of modern economic and business systems. It prepares students to contribute effectively to issues related to production, distribution, allocation and optimal utilization of resources in a sustainable and inclusive manner.

Key Features Aligned with NEP 2020

- Multidisciplinary and holistic education
- Skill enhancement and vocational integration
- Experiential learning, internships and project-based learning
- Research orientation (especially in the 4th year for Honours/Research track)
- Digital literacy and emerging technologies
- Environmental sustainability and social responsibility
- Flexibility through Choice Based Credit System (CBCS)

The programme provides a strong theoretical foundation in commerce and economics while fostering critical analysis of economic structures, governance mechanisms and business environments. It enhances research aptitude and encourages applied research in selected domains.

Furthermore, the programme aims to develop adaptability, innovation, entrepreneurial mindset and lifelong learning skills among students, enabling them to respond effectively to dynamic socio-economic changes and contribute meaningfully to society and national development.

Bachelor of Social Work or (BSW) is a professional degree that is offered at the undergraduate (UG) level. The duration of a BSW course is three years and candidates need to positively complete the course within a maximum duration of six years as per the guidelines of the affiliating University. At the Bhopal School of Social Sciences (BSSS), students can undertake BSW as a full-time course only. BSW course mostly comprises of four major parts which are core courses, foundation course, and fieldwork.

Components of the BSW Programme:

The programme has been designed to inculcate initial training and orientation to students towards being compassionate human beings and achieve soft professional skills. The further advanced training in the programme includes training on certain essential technical aspects like analysis and technical writing. The objective of this programme is to train young professional social workers so that they can socially commit themselves and become professionally competent to contribute towards the social development of the country. Concurrent Field Work, Block Placement, Rural Camp, Study Tour and Dissertation are the mandatory practical components of this programme.

Eligibility Criteria

A candidate must have completed higher secondary (10+2) with a minimum of 45% of marks and from any streams in 12th standard is eligible to apply for the programme. There are a total of 60 seats in the programme and as per the admission policy of the college, admissions are offered every year. Reservations and other mandates are applicable as per the existing norms and rules as presribed by the Higher Education Department of Madhya Pradesh.

Opportunities after the Programme

BSW programme is one of the more competitive Under-graduate programmes that equip students with required humane, professional and technical skills to seek jobs in NGO and Development sector. Students can go for higher education with specialised skills for these sectors.

\n===== mba-twinning-programme-assumption-university-thailand =====
MBA Twinning Programme - Assumption University, Thailand
  ---------- ---------------
  Category   International
  ---------- ---------------
  ------------- ------------
  Eligibility   Graduation
  ------------- ------------
  ---------- ---------
  Duration   2 Years
  ---------- ---------
The Bhopal School of Social Sciences is a pioneering undergraduate and postgraduate college of Management. A major focus area is the development of entrepreneurial, managerial and communication skills.
In keeping with these objectives, the college collaborates with Assumption University, Bangkok for a twinning program of four semesters MBA by which the students can specialize in areas of Management in an international environment as part of an international community without incurring very high costs. This international exposure helps position our students better in the highly competitive global job market.
Assumption University
Assumption University is the first International University in Thailand.  The university is a non-profit institution administered by the Brothers of St. Gabriel, a worldwide Catholic Religious Order. The university is an international community of scholars engaged in the pursuit of truth and knowledge, serving in the human society, especially through the creative use of interdisciplinary approaches and cyber technology. In addition to being accredited fully by the Ministry of University Affairs, Government of Thailand, it is also listed in the handbook of International Association of Universities and that of many institutions. Assumption University welcomes students from other countries and has students from more than 40 countries on its rolls.
Twinning Concept
Twinning educational programmes is a unique and creative concept in education. It provides an opportunity and access to students for studies abroad.  The students complete a part of the course in BSSS, Bhopal, India and complete the remaining semesters of their studies at the designated foreign university, which in this case is Assumption University (AU), Bangkok, Thailand.
Facts at a Glance
- Syllabus framed by Assumption University, Degree awarded by Assumption University.
- Students transfer to Assumption University, Bangkok, after completing one semester in BSSS.
Programs, Duration & Venue
- MBA-Masters of Business Administration.
-  MS-TechM-Masters in Technology Management.
For both these four semester programs the students will study for one semester at BSSS Bhopal and for the remaining three at Assumption University, Bangkok.
Eligibility:  A Bachelor Degree in any field with a minimum of 55% aggregate.
Major Benefits
- International exposure and environment.
- Becoming an International student - cross - cultural interaction and experience.
-  Saving costs - the expenses will be similar or less than what you might spend at some of the Indian Institutions.
- The college will lend full support to help applicants to procure educational       loan to cover your entire expenses abroad.
- Guaranteed admission to Assumption University - provided you fulfill the criteria.
- Excellent placement opportunities globally as well as in the growing economies of South East Asia.
Visa Students are expected to fulfill all visa requirements and formalities. However, the BSSS will provide guidance and assistance needed to procure the visa.
Course covered at BSSS
  -------------------------------- -------------------------------------------
  1. Foundation in Management      2. Foundation in Marketing
  3. Foundation in Finance         4. Introduction to Quantitative Analysis
  5. Introduction to Accounting    6. Case Study Dynamics
  7. Managerial Accounting         8. Managerial Economics
  9. Research Methodology           
  -------------------------------- -------------------------------------------
The remaining core subjects and specialization papers will be offered at Assumption University as per the choice of the students.
For more details contact:
Department of Commerce (BSSS)
International Program Coordinator
MBA Twinning PGM with Assumption University, Bangkok, Thailand
\n===== cambridge-english-empower =====
Cambridge English EMPOWER
  ---------- ---------------
  Category   International
  ---------- ---------------
  ------------- ------------
  Eligibility   Graduation
  ------------- ------------
  ---------- ---------
  Duration   60 hrs.
  ---------- ---------
Cambridge Empower B2 Upper-Intermediate Certificate Course
It is a general English course for adult and young adult learners, taking students from beginner to Advanced level (CEFR A1 to C1). Empower combines course content from Cambridge University Press with validated assessment from the experts at Cambridge Assessment English.
 Empower’s unique mix of engaging classroom materials and reliable assessment enables learners to make consistent and measurable progress. The content consists of thought-provoking images, texts, and speaking activities along with audio and video files to arouse curiosity among learners.  
Course Hours - 60hrs.
Modules - 10
Fees - Rs. 5000
\n===== cambridge-english-upskills =====
Cambridge English UPSKILLS
  ---------- ---------------
  Category   International
  ---------- ---------------
  ------------- ------------
  Eligibility   Graduation
  ------------- ------------
  ---------- ---------
  Duration   60 hrs.
  ---------- ---------
CAMBRIDGE ENGLISH UPSKILLS
Upskill from Cambridge is the latest state-of-the-art technology-based language assessment to be delivered on mobile phones, offered by the producers of IELTS. The test is a completely mobile, remotely proctored English exam delivered on Android phones driven using artificial intelligence. Upskill tests all four skills: Reading and Listening, Speaking, and Writing.   
Being completely mobile, the test offers an extremely convenient way for candidates to take an assessment anywhere anytime, and get instant results through an official report from an internationally recognized examination board.  This will indicate the candidate’s overall score and your score for each skill using the CEFR level scale. The international standard for describing language ability is the Common European Framework of             Reference for Languages (CEFR). It describes language ability on a six-point scale, from A1 for beginners, up to C2 for those who have mastered a language, and has a set of CAN-DO statements. The Upskill report will tell the candidate and the organization what each score means in terms of English language ability. 
The whole test is delivered in a chunked format – this means that once started the test can be taken in small 15-20 min portions over a 5-day period, whenever the candidate has time, and is remotely proctored for authentication. 
Course Hours - 60hrs.
Modules - 10
Fees - Rs. 5000

A Three-year degree course:

Bachelor of Arts in Management is an undergraduate Business management course. Management is the process of planning, organizing, leading, and controlling that encompasses human, material, and financial resources in an organizational environment. This course has been designed to enable you to operate successfully in the increasingly complex and demanding business environment. This Management degree course will provide you with a thorough knowledge and understanding of the nature and context of business, the principal management functions and the skills required for effective management in different organizations. The duration of programme is three years and after passing the course they have further jobs and study scopes.

Course Fees - 10,000/-
1.  Digital Marketing (NSQF) (Course Summary)
    This course, with a duration of notional teaching of 600 hours, comprises 26 modules, designed to provide a detailed understanding of the subject. The course structure includes both theoretical and practical components, ensuring a balanced approach to learning. Additionally, there will be exposure visits/observation to relevant industry sites or organizations to offer practical insights and real-world learning experiences. An internship of 45 hours is mandatory to appear for the final assessment.
    The course will be taught by a mix of internal and external faculty, depending on the expertise required for each module. Upon successful completion, students will receive certification from BSSS. A mandatory attendance of 75% is required to qualify for certification. The internal assessment, totalling 40 marks, will be based on assignments, projects, case studies and other assessments, while the external assessment will be out of 60 marks. Students will be awarded grades according to the total marks obtained from both internal and external evaluations.
    The expected course outcomes include:
    - Design and develop functional websites and compelling graphics
    - Implement and manage effective search engine marketing and advanced web analytics strategies
    - Create and deploy engaging display and video marketing campaigns
    - Gain valuable practical experience through extensive industrial training
    - Use digital marketing tools effectively
    - Create smart online marketing plans
    - Run successful marketing campaigns
    - Understand and analyze website data
    - Build a portfolio showcasing new digital marketing skills
    This ensures that students are well-equipped with the knowledge and skills required in the field.
2.  Human Resource Management (Course Summary)
    This course, with a duration of notional teaching of 600 hours, comprises 4 modules, designed to provide a detailed understanding of the subject. The course structure includes both theoretical and practical components, ensuring a balanced approach to learning. Additionally, an industrial visit to relevant industry sites or organizations will offer practical insights and real-world learning experiences. The internship of 180 hours is to be completed by the students.
    The course will be taught by a mix of internal and external faculty. Upon successful completion, students will receive certification from BSSS. A mandatory attendance of 75% is required to qualify for certification. The internal assessment, totaling 40 marks, will be based on presentations, assignments, projects, case studies, and other assessments, while the external assessment will be out of 60 marks. Students will be awarded grades according to the total marks obtained from both internal and external evaluations.
    Upon successful completion of the Certificate Course in Human Resource Management, the student should be able to:
    1.  Understand fundamental concepts of Human Resource Management (HRM)
    2.  Analyze organizational behavior and workplace dynamics
    3.  Examine industrial relations and labour welfare in India
    4.  Develop research skills for HRM applications
    Gain practical exposure through industry internship
3.  Travel & Tourism (NSQF) (Course Summary)
    This course, with a duration of notional teaching of 600 hours, comprises 08 modules, designed to provide a detailed understanding of the subject. The course structure includes both theoretical and practical components, ensuring a balanced approach to learning. Additionally, there will be 02 exposure visits/observation visits to relevant industry sites or organizations to offer practical insights and real-world learning experiences from internship in industry.
    The course will be taught by a mix of internal and external faculty, depending on the expertise required for each module. Upon successful completion, students will receive certification from BSSS. A mandatory attendance of 75% is required to qualify for certification.
    The internal assessment, totalling 40 marks, will be based on presentations, assignments, projects, case studies, field reports, documentaries, and other assessments, while the external assessment will be out of 60 marks. Students will be awarded grades according to the total marks obtained from both internal and external evaluations.
    The expected course outcomes include the application of the concepts and skills necessary to achieve tourist satisfaction. After completion of the course, students would be able to present themselves in a professional and ethical manner and implement industry-defined work ethics. The course would help them interact effectively and confidently in the classroom, community, and industry, and establish teamwork to achieve set goals. The course ensures that students are well-equipped with the knowledge and skills required in the field.
4.  NGO Management and CSR (Only for MSW Students) (Course Summary)
    The Diploma in NGO Management and Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR) is a two-semester academic program designed to build foundational and advanced competencies in the non-profit and CSR sectors. Each semester includes five courses—four theory papers and one field-based project work, allowing students to blend classroom learning with real-world application.
    The diploma spans a total of 980 hours (490 hours per semester), which includes structured classroom sessions, fieldwork, and dedicated library hours for independent study and research.
    The program covers key areas such as NGO governance, financial and legal compliance, project design and evaluation, stakeholder engagement, and CSR strategy under Indian regulatory frameworks. Emphasis is placed on developing leadership and management skills essential for navigating today’s social development landscape.
    Students gain practical exposure through field projects, enabling them to work closely with NGOs or CSR wings of corporates. This hands-on experience fosters critical thinking, problem-solving, and a commitment to ethical and sustainable development.
    Ideal for students, aspiring social entrepreneurs, and professionals in the development sector, this diploma prepares graduates to effectively lead and innovate in the realms of civil society and corporate social responsibility.
